headers.To: registration.email (validated: no whitespace or control characters)
headers.Subject: Registration confirmation {registrationNumber}

lines: thank you for registering for the conference.

paymentParagraph.paying: The invoice for {grossFee} EUR will be sent to you separately by our accounting department. Please pay according to the invoice.
paymentParagraph.student: As a student you participate free of charge. The organizer may ask you to show proof of your student status.

rules: Placeholders are replaced with plain text; no markup is interpreted.
Amounts use exactly two decimals and a dot as decimal separator.
The VAT ID part of the payer line is omitted when companyVatId is null.
Characters such as č, š, ž are sent unchanged (UTF-8).
